title: Velocity at B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates v_B = 4 m/s using kinematics on the incline with proper acceleration.

title: Velocity at C
description: Essential: Correctly determines v_C = 0 m/s from kinematics on BC with friction.

title: Time CD calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes total time t_CD = (2√7 - 4) s, matching the reference solution.

title: Incline acceleration
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law on AB to find a₁ = 1 m/s² from F, gravity, and no friction.

title: BC friction analysis
description: Important: Identifies kinetic friction as the sole horizontal force on BC, giving a₂ = 5 m/s².

title: Two-phase CD motion
description: Important: Recognizes two distinct acceleration phases on CD: before and after matching belt speed.

title: CD accelerations
description: Important: Correctly computes a₃ = 10 m/s² (up incline) and a₄ = 2 m/s² (up incline) using forces with belt motion.

title: Sign/direction errors
description: Pitfall: Misapplies sign of friction or gravity on CD when belt direction changes, or confuses relative motion.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s, m/s²) throughout calculations.
